sections.title: Phần 2 — Đọc hiểu
sections.instructions: Đọc đoạn văn, trả lời 5 câu.
sections.passage: My Daily Routine. I usually get up at six o'clock. First, I make the bed and take a shower. Then I have a quick breakfast — usually some bread and an egg. I commute to work by motorbike; it takes about twenty minutes. I have worked at an IT company for five years, and I really enjoy it because my colleagues are friendly and the work is challenging. In the evening, I do some exercise to stay fit, and I try to eat a balanced diet. At weekends, I hang out with my family and visit my relatives.

questions.question: What time does the writer get up?
How does the writer go to work?
How long has the writer worked at the company?
Why does the writer enjoy the job?
questions.suggestedAnswer: Because his colleagues are friendly and the work is challenging.

questions.question: What does the writer do at weekends?
questions.suggestedAnswer: He hangs out with his family and visits his relatives.

tasks.label: Task 1
tasks.prompt: Viết email cho một người bạn kể về công việc và một ngày điển hình của bạn.

tasks.label: Task 2
tasks.prompt: "A healthy lifestyle is important for everyone." Bạn có đồng ý không? Nêu ý kiến và ví dụ.

parts.prompt: Trả lời: Where are you from? What do you do? Describe your daily routine.
Nói 1 phút: Describe a trip you are going to take.
Nêu quan điểm: Do you think home-cooked food is better than fast food? Why?

scoringNote: Phần 1 (20 câu): số đúng ÷ 2 = điểm. Phần 2 (5 câu): số đúng × 2. Writing & Speaking nhờ AI/giáo viên chấm theo tiêu chí VSTEP.
goalNote: Ghi điểm vào mục Tiến độ → mục tiêu Tháng 1 ~4.5–5.0.
